data.body: **[P2] Accept independently verified worker retirement as settlement.** A worker retired at its deadline cannot emit either wrapper-exit event. Although `evidence.deadline()` permits retirement, this predicate remains false even after recovery establishes full capacity in the original environment. Teardown then fails permanently, and `configuration['pending']` prevents subsequent cases from running. Carry request/process-correlated retirement evidence into settlement alongside wrapper exits, while continuing to reject unproven termination. Cover retirement without a final wrapper diagnostic.
